what: Proposed KILL-escalation test uses `trap '' TERM; sleep 1860 &` in the test harness parent
scenario_or_breakage: Bash traps are not inherited by background children; `sleep` still exits on SIGTERM, so the test passes when TERM alone kills the child and never exercises the 5× `kill -0` loop or SIGKILL
suggested_fix: Launch a TERM-ignoring child in the test body, e.g. `bash -c 'trap "" TERM; while sleep 1; do :; done' &`, write its PID to the paired file, then assert the process is gone only after ~5s (or use `kill -0` polling in the test)
